description_sq:
Apartament 3+1 ne shitje ne Yzberisht!
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 banim te nje pallati te mireadministruar me ashensor.
Eshte i organizuar ne nje sallon te bollshem me kuzhinen e vecuar, 3 dhoma gjumi, nje tualet me dritare, nje korridor qe realizon shperndarjen e dhomave te gjumit,dhe nje ballkon i cili ndodhet ne sallon.
Orjentimi i apartamentit eshte jug-perendim.
Shitet totalisht i mobiluar.
Ndodhet ne nje zone teper te qete dhe me te gjitha akseset dhe sherbimet prane.
Per me teper informacione na kontaktoni!
description_en: 3+1 apartment for sale in Yzberisht! The apartment is located on the 5th residential floor of a well-managed building with an elevator. It is organized in a spacious living room with a separate kitchen, 3 bedrooms, a bathroom with a window, a corridor that distributes the bedrooms, and a balcony located in the living room. The orientation of the apartment is south-west. For sale fully furnished. It is located in a very quiet area and with all accesses and services nearby. For more information contact us!
